sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Plocosperma buxifolium is an evergreen shrub or small tree, about 1–3.5 m tall, known from Mexico into Central America. It is the sole species of the family Plocospermataceae.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its opposite leaves are small, about 0.6–1.5 cm long. Pink to purple flowers develop into narrow, curved capsules 3.5–7.2 cm long, containing one to four seeds with long silky hairs.
